Thank you for your review.

I am sorry to read you have been having problems getting an appointment. 

Unfortunately, due to a reduction in funding to Midlothian Practices, by NHS Lothian, we have fewer medical appointments available. This, coupled with increased demand for appointments means that we have days when there are not enough appointments for everyone.

We would like people to be able to obtain an appointment easily and without having to call back. Our current performance isn’t the service we want to offer but with approx. 20% cuts to our Doctors appointments we are left with little choice to ask people to call back the following day when we are full.  

Currently we offer approx. 850 appointments a week.

We are asking patients to contact their local Councillors or MSP to show the real impact of these cuts to our patients, you can see more about this on our website - Service Cuts - Penicuik Medical Practice (penicuikhealthcentre.co.uk)

In the meantime, we are looking at what we can control, we have introduced a new telephone system that allows patients to take their place in the queue and not have to stay on hold, we will know your place in the queue and call you when a team member is available.  This will at least take away the inconvenience of staying on hold.  

I have checked in with the Reception team who advised they were trying to explain the process to you and the challenges in General Practice.  It was not their intention to come across as uncaring and apologies from the Practice if it left you feeling this way.

Unfortunately, due to Doctor shortage today, the 70 appointments we had available we taken very quickly this morning.

I hope this helps explains the challenges we're currently facing.

Regards

Penicuik Medical Practice.

We are asking patients to contact their local Councillors or MSP to show the real impact of these cuts to our patients, you can see more about this on our website - Service Cuts - Penicuik Medical Practice (penicuikhealthcentre.co.uk)

This will at least take away the inconvenience of staying on hold.  

I have checked in with the Reception team who advised they were trying to explain the process to you and the challenges in General Practice.  It was not their intention to come across as uncaring and apologies from the Practice if it left you feeling this way.

Unfortunately, due to Doctor shortage today, the 70 appointments we had available we taken very quickly this morning.

I hope this helps explains the challenges we're currently facing.

Regards

Penicuik Medical Practice.
